subtitle: A resort settlement on Greece's Thermaic Gulf, uninhabited until 1980, renamed Olympic Beach in 1986 for a mountain it merely faces from 26 kilometers away.
spike_statement: Olympic Beach was uninhabited until 1980, called Seaside Katerini until 1986, and named for a mountain it only ever faces, 26 km away.

levers.photo_tone: Flat gray-blue Thermaic Gulf water under a hazy summer sky, Mount Olympus a faint pale silhouette far inland, the shore itself a modest strip of sunbeds, bungalows, and small hotels rather than a mythic vista
